note: Fantasy Empires remake (LostMystic): where the bot goes for each kind of update. Words are matched against the new lines of the game's web/CHANGES.txt (its version.json notes). Steps are pressed by the bot: --screen campaign opens New Game on 'New campaign'; Down picks 'Campaign 2: the hero's road', Up then Return is 'Begin your journey', Return is 'Set off'. Then the bot clicks about the map, which walks the hero.
